body.name: measurable covariance ridge convention
body.construction: For the original sample, every empirical-bootstrap resample, and every multiplier derivative, replace an inverse of an empirical instrument covariance block \(S_{zz}\) by \(R_n(S_{zz})=(S_{zz}+n^{-2}I_d)^{-1}\). Compute reduced forms and \(\mathfrak q_n\) from this same map on every sample; no procedure is conditioned on empirical invertibility.
